issues_ledger.current_claim: Option C probability fusion restores mean ROC-AUC to 0.9970, improving detection accuracy...
issues_ledger.problem: Pure Random Forest clean mean ROC-AUC (0.9976) is slightly higher than Option C (0.9970). Option C does NOT improve clean detection accuracy over RF.
issues_ledger.safe_replacement_wording: Option C preserves near-RF clean detection performance (0.9970 vs 0.9976) while enabling neural privacy and robustness studies.

issues_ledger.current_claim: Option C provides robust white-box defense against adversarial attacks.
issues_ledger.problem: Discrete decision trees prevent exact white-box gradient computation. Phase 5 evaluates a surrogate-based adaptive attack. Evasion ASR increases to 11.8% on Edge-IIoTset (+8.0 pp).
issues_ledger.safe_replacement_wording: Under an adaptive surrogate-gradient attack, Option C evasion increases to 11.8% on Edge-IIoTset, demonstrating that neural-stream robustness does not imply complete immunity to adaptive surrogate attacks.

issues_ledger.current_claim: An adversarially robust and differentially private AI framework for IoT intrusion detection...
issues_ledger.problem: DP-SGD applies exclusively to the neural stream branch. The Random Forest stream and full Option C ensemble are non-private.
issues_ledger.safe_replacement_wording: Differential privacy (eps=2.37, delta=10^-5) is guaranteed exclusively on the neural stream branch; the Random Forest classifier is non-private.

issues_ledger.current_claim: Explainability via SHAP attributions for the fused Option C model.
issues_ledger.problem: Attribution is calculated as 0.7 * RF_norm + 0.3 * MLP_norm. It is a weighted component-level attribution, not exact game-theoretic SHAP for the non-linear fused predictor.
issues_ledger.safe_replacement_wording: Model explainability is delivered via Weighted Component Attribution Aggregation (0.7 RF + 0.3 MLP), not exact game-theoretic SHAP for the non-linear fused predictor.

issues_ledger.current_claim: Host latency benchmarks establish a pure detection throughput of 16,505 samples/sec...
issues_ledger.problem: Benchmark measures classifier execution latency only. It excludes packet capture, flow construction, feature extraction, and XAI.
issues_ledger.safe_replacement_wording: Single-CPU host classifier inference throughput reaches 16,505 samples/sec at batch size N=1024, excluding network ingress and feature extraction.

issues_ledger.current_claim: A surrogate model faithfully approximates Random Forest decision boundaries.
issues_ledger.problem: Surrogate validation R^2 varies significantly across datasets (Edge: -0.59, NF: +0.95, ToN: +0.04, CIC: +0.54). High fidelity cannot be claimed universally.
issues_ledger.safe_replacement_wording: Surrogate model fidelity varies across network distributions (R^2 = -0.59 to +0.95), reflecting differences in decision tree boundary complexity.

issues_ledger.current_claim: Non-overlapping confidence intervals prove statistical significance.
issues_ledger.problem: Bootstrap CIs quantify finite-sample sampling uncertainty on held-out test splits; they do not constitute a formal paired significance test (e.g., DeLong test).
issues_ledger.safe_replacement_wording: Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals quantify sampling variation on the test split; formal paired hypothesis testing was not performed.

issues_ledger.current_claim: Feature attributions across all attack sub-categories demonstrate threat-specific patterns.
issues_ledger.problem: Certain CICIoT2023 categories have very small sample counts (MITM N=11, Scanning N=9, Attack N=3).
issues_ledger.safe_replacement_wording: Feature attributions for low-frequency attack categories (N < 50) represent descriptive sample observations rather than statistically generalizable patterns.
